# Bellari Home Remodeling

> > Bellari is a family-owned home remodeling company serving New Jersey with exterior and interior renovation services including roofing, siding, windows, bathrooms, and decking.

Operating primarily in Somerset, Hunterdon, and Middlesex Counties, Bellari is a third-generation family business that has evolved from Somerville Aluminum into a comprehensive home remodeling contractor. The company is recognized among America's Top 500 largest remodelers and emphasizes energy-efficient solutions and community partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Home remodeling services
- Roofing replacement and repair
- Siding installation (vinyl, wood, fiber-cement)
- Energy-efficient windows
- Bathroom renovation
- New Jersey service areas (Somerset, Hunterdon, Middlesex Counties)
- Composite vs wood decking
- Storm damage repair
- Curb appeal enhancement
- Home insurance impacts
- Energy Star certification
- Family-owned business (third generation)
- Community partnerships
- Top 500 remodeler ranking
